rationale: The assistant correctly linked Er03 to the boil-over and gave safe advice, but its first answer misdescribed the code as moisture 'seeped under the glass' onto electronics with an unnecessary 24-hour isolation, missing the simpler, correct step of wiping the touch controls dry and power cycling, and never asked whether anything was sitting on or wetting the controls. When the customer reported it already worked after drying and a 5-minute reset, it sensibly dropped the 24-hour advice and gave proportionate prevention guidance with no parts or escalation. No fabricated evidence or unsafe instructions; the outcome matches the hidden truth, largely thanks to the customer's own action.
